purpose: Define the shared editor substrate used by Expose editors for identity resolution, schema-driven fields, validation, change staging, authorization, apply/reload and error reporting.

topics.name: Expose Editor Shared Foundation
topics.purpose: Define the shared editor substrate used by Expose editors for identity resolution, schema-driven fields, validation, change staging, authorization, apply/reload and error reporting.

semantics.identity_rule: Editor target resolves by exact canonical identity.
semantics.schema_rule: Editor fields/ports/controls derive from explicit target schema/contract metadata.
semantics.candidate_rule: Edits are staged as candidate changes before authoritative apply where applicable.
semantics.authority_rule: Every mutation uses normal AccessCore/runtime authority checks.
semantics.reuse_rule: Specialized editors reuse this foundation rather than reimplementing parallel change pipelines.
semantics.state_rule: UI-local state is distinct from canonical definition and runtime state.

invariants.rule: Editor surfaces project and mutate canonical semantics only through explicit validated operations; editor layout or widget state never becomes semantic or runtime authority.

hard_gates.condition: UI-local state treated as canonical state
specialized editor creates incompatible private mutation path

references.purpose: Editor writes cross explicit change boundary.
